title: Capstone: Untangle the Invite Merge Mess
description:
**SITUATION:**

A colleague left `~/sprint-service` in a bad state right as Product is locking **workspace invites** for the next enterprise rollout.

**HEAD is detached** — they checked out a commit instead of a branch and made a commit (Document workspace invites in README) that no branch points to. From there they started merging `feature/workspace-invites` and stopped on a conflict in `config/app.conf`. Leftover files from the failed attempt are still on disk (`config/app.conf.orig`, `config/app.conf.rej`).

`main` itself still points at its hotfix tip. Ops signed off on `invite_link_ttl_hours = 168` (a full week) — not either side of the conflict — and that value must win. Jordan asked you to untangle the mess so `main` ends clean with the hotfix, the invites feature, and the orphaned README commit.

Your identity (Ada Learner) is already configured. Start in `~/sprint-service` (**detached HEAD**, merge in progress).

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Resolve the conflict in `config/app.conf` with `invite_link_ttl_hours = 168`, keep `workers = 4` and the `[invites]` redeem settings, finish the merge, and remove leftover `.orig` / `.rej` files so they are not committed.
2. Re-attach to `main` so it contains the hotfix, the whole workspace-invites feature, and the README commit. End on `main` with a clean working tree — no merge in progress, no conflict markers.

hints: git status and git log --oneline --graph --all show detached HEAD and the merge in progress.
In config/app.conf set invite_link_ttl_hours = 168 (Ops), keep workers = 4 and redeem settings; git add and commit to finish the merge.
Delete config/app.conf.orig and config/app.conf.rej so they never land on main.
Move the recovered tip onto main (e.g. git branch -f main HEAD && git switch main) so main is not left detached.
problemStatement.overview: Detached HEAD, half-finished invites merge, orphaned README commit, leftover `.orig`/`.rej`. End clean on `main` with `invite_link_ttl_hours` = 168.
problemStatement.brief: Untangle detached HEAD + invites merge conflict. TTL 168 on `main`, keep hotfix and feature history, clean tree.
problemStatement.solution:
## 1. Diagnose

```bash
cd ~/sprint-service
git status
git log --oneline --graph --all
```

You will see: HEAD detached, `MERGE_HEAD` present, `config/app.conf` unmerged, two untracked leftover files, and a commit not reachable from any branch.

## 2. Resolve the conflict

```bash
cat config/app.conf
```

Keep a single `invite_link_ttl_hours = 168` under `[invites]`, keep `workers = 4` and `redeem_code_length = 8`, and delete all marker lines.

```bash
nano config/app.conf
grep -n '<<<<<<<\|=======\|>>>>>>>' config/app.conf || echo "no markers"
```

## 3. Clean up leftovers

```bash
rm config/app.conf.orig config/app.conf.rej
```

## 4. Finish the merge

```bash
git add -A
git commit --no-edit
git log --oneline --graph --all
```

The merge commit's first parent is the orphaned "Document workspace invites in README" commit, so it is now in this line of history.

## 5. Re-attach `main`

```bash
git switch -C main          # point main at this commit and check it out
git branch --show-current   # main
```

`main`'s old tip (the hotfix) is an ancestor of the merge, so nothing is lost.

## 6. Verify

```bash
git status
git log --oneline --graph
git show main:config/app.conf
ls config                   # no .orig / .rej
```

## Lessons

- A detached HEAD is fine for looking around; commit there and you must save the work (`git switch -c <branch>`).
- `git merge --abort` is the escape hatch for an unfinished merge; `git reflog` finds commits that no branch references.
- Never commit `*.orig` / `*.rej` leftovers.
